review_role: Independent technical helper review; not owner approval or authorization
scope: Static read-only review of the three root closeout helpers, CLI/schema compatibility and current safe environment receipt shape

findings.issue: Proposal path set is trusted without exact governance allowlist, containment or redirect rejection.
findings.consequence: A self-consistent additional proposal entry can modify LATEST_RUN, a frozen path or a path outside the repository. scan_public_bytes/forbidden_path do not reject parent traversal or enforce the ten-file governance scope.
findings.required_fix: Before any file read or write, require exact unique input/output sets matching the ten approved governance files, safe relative paths, target containment and no symlink/reparse ancestors. Reject extra/missing/duplicate paths. Apply the same redirect checks to fixed report/tool input and target paths.

findings.issue: Audited main export is not transitively bound to proposed governance or rendered report bytes.
findings.consequence: Campaign/status identity and each proposal's self-declared hashes can pass while stale or modified metrics or permission flags are copied into governance/reports. RESULTS.md/CONFIGURATION_TABLE.csv have no renderer receipt check at application time.
findings.required_fix: Check proposal.safe_export_inputs against current audited main file SHA256/size; check top-level closed training/research authority and preserved39 preregistration; bind rendered output hashes to the actual renderer receipt or a fresh fixed-helper outside rerender comparison. Validate condition campaign/main-export provenance as part of the same input chain.

verified_observations: CLI arguments match the current exporter/condition exporter/renderer/governance updater definitions.
Main and condition manifests use size, while governance proposal members use size_bytes, and assembler accesses these correctly.
Official writes occur after the declared termination, audit, Git branch/origin/local-remote, clean-tree and candidate scanning code paths.
